data.topic: Why Vector Databases Matter for AI Agents
facts: Vector databases index high-dimensional embeddings using algorithms like HNSW.
Traditional relational databases index scalar fields and cannot perform approximate nearest neighbor search efficiently.
Dense retrieval enables RAG architectures to ground LLMs on private external knowledge.
angles_discovered: The geometric intuition: turning semantic meaning into spatial coordinates.
The memory bottleneck: why prompt context windows alone cannot replace vector search.
